text:
anya: putting a proposal on the table: a console card that visualizes per-token "sensitivity" and cache-hit likelihood by position + model variant. goal is to help routing choose cheaper variants for low-sensitivity prefixes and make cache savings auditable. quick sketch below.

pj: neat. main red flag is cardinality. per-token telemetry explodes. what aggregation/sampling do you have in mind?

anya: two layers: UI shows coarse buckets (1, 2-8, 9-32, 33-128, 129+). backend stores histogram summaries at 0.5% sample rate and raw per-request aggregates for 7 days for postmortem. only counts, no text.

mike: 0.5% on 50k reqs/min still creates load. alternative: derive cache-hit probs from router's KV warmup traces and emit a bounded proto per request with bucket counts. example proto: 
```
route: "/api/v1/gen"
model: "rw-13b-q4"
buckets: [3, 20, 30, 7, 0]
cache_hits: [1, 16, 27, 5, 0]
tokens: 60
latency_ms: 210
```
that way events are fixed-size.

elaine: for the "sensitivity" metric we can precompute a cost-sensitivity score offline per promptshape+model: expected delta in loss and token cost when routing to a cheaper variant. UI surfaces it as a 0-100 score.

dan: two operator requirements: (1) a what-if slider to preview routing percentages and projected cost/latency deltas; (2) an attribution breakdown: how much of the cache savings is tenant-owned vs shared prefetch. billing needs that.

pj: rollout plan: feature-flagged behind opt-in, only enable for routes with >= 500 rps to avoid noisy microservices. aggregator windows to 60s summaries and writes to cost-index. add a backpressure metric if Kafka partitions backlog.

mike: infra tasks: router proto change + lightweight router-side reservoir sampler + aggregator job + cost-index schema + console chart. prototype path: reuse current cost pipeline and a feature-gated shim in router to emit bucketed protos. estimate 2 sprints for prototype + 1 sprint for hardening.

anya: privacy/security: do not persist any prompt text. counts-only policy and auto-ttl 7 days for sampled histograms. for Private deployments apply KMS tag and local retention policy.

elaine: about the sensitivity computation: we'll need a small evaluation harness that runs a representative set of promptshapes through pairs of model variants to estimate marginal token-level quality impact. store the result as a sparse table keyed by promptshape.

dan: reconciliation: hourly job consumes sampled bucketed events to reconcile dashboard projections with invoiceable per-token counts. create alert if delta > 1.5% over a day.

pj: ops knobs: if telemetry pipeline saturates, fall back to router-level reservoir sampling and emit a deploy-warning metric. also allow pausing heatmap generation per-cluster.

mike: small UX ask: the heatmap should be clickable by bucket to show a quick breakdown: sample count, mean latency, cache-hit fraction, sensitivity score, and sample variance. tooltip also links to the reconciliation job status.

anya: OK actioning: @pj to draft infra design doc and retention/KMS policy. @mike to spin up a prototype shim that emits the bucketed proto to staging. @elaine to own sensitivity scoring docs and sample harness. i'll mock the dashboard card and the what-if slider. can we sync tomorrow 10am?

pj: ack, i'll start the infra doc and include failure modes.

deploy-bot: deploy started: cost-telemetry-proxy v0.3 -> staging (CI #4589)

mike: watching staging logs for proto schema. will post sample events here.

anya: thanks team, keeping initial rollout small will help validate the value without burning cycles. :rocket:
